vectors.name: line_side_zero

vectors.name: polygon_square_edges_vertices

vectors.name: polygon_concave_slanted_edges

vectors.name: attempt_window_overlap
vectors.description: Attempts at 10 and 30 with W = 50: attempt 1 ends at the next rising(valid_attempt) (30), so the success at 35 belongs to attempt 2 only. Leg 1 (1 attempt) False, leg 2 (2 attempts) True

vectors.name: rising_at_frame_0
vectors.description: success true from absolute frame 0 (rises there: frame 0 has no predecessor) and true from the start of segment [10,13) (no rise: a segment start f ≠ 0 has no prev). count == 1

vectors.name: level_success_across_attempts
vectors.description: success is a level that turns true at 15 and stays true. Attempt 1 (10) gets it (rising at 15); attempt 2 (30) does not, because success never rises again ⇒ count 1 < 2

vectors.name: enters_one_frame_dropout
vectors.description: enters across a one-frame dropout (lastSeen bridges gaps ≤ RELEASE_GAP: fires at 6) vs. a three-frame dropout (gap 4: no event)

vectors.name: released_by_occluded_hold
vectors.description: released_by after a hold interrupted by one occluded frame (heldrun bridges absent gaps ≤ RELEASE_GAP: release at 3) vs. a single held frame (heldrun 1 < RELEASE_HOLD: no release)

vectors.name: event_in_tail_frames

vectors.name: still_jitter_5px

vectors.name: holds_fail_predicate

vectors.name: holds_intact_boundary

vectors.name: unknown_coverage_gap

vectors.name: unknown_conf

vectors.name: conf_at_threshold

vectors.name: unknown_motion

vectors.name: reason_13_window_unavailable

vectors.name: checkpoints_more_than_8

vectors.name: cost_exceeded

vectors.name: quantize_multi_ball_rebind

Decisive windows ⇒ 2 attempts, 2 successes

vectors.name: identity_greedy_conflict
vectors.description: fuseTimeline + bindPersons (§8.5): at frame 0 track 1 scores p0 conf 60 / p1 conf 24 and track 0 scores p0 conf 80. Greedy stitching gives p0 → track 0 and the leftover track 1 → p1 with id_conf 24, so leg 3 (maya present, checkpoint (1, 0)) is Unknown (IDENTITY) even with every checkpoint verified; by frame 12 track 1 is clearly p1 (leg 2 passes)
